description: Public A100 SXM4 80GB idle observations plus explicit, uncalibrated simulation assumptions. Not maintainer hardware or a performance calibration.

sources.scope: Eight idle A100 SXM4 80GB devices. Only numeric sensor observations retained; no hardware identities.
Standard 80GB SXM: 400W TDP and 2039 GB/s memory bandwidth.

simulation_assumptions.activity_source: CPU dispatch execution duty cycle, not measured or predicted A100 execution time
simulation_assumptions.memory_utilization_source: estimated tensor input/output bytes per second divided by reference HBM bandwidth; not memory capacity percentage
